note: Full 2026 schedule with per-game win probabilities. `src` says where each probability came from: "market" = derived from a real line, "model" = Elo-only. Ownership is modelled, not observed.

field_notes.mk: market-implied home win probability (null when no line); derivation and provenance are named by mk_src
field_notes.mk_obs: when the market input was observed; null when no line
field_notes.mk_book: source book; null because the nfelo upstream output does not identify it
field_notes.p: blended home win probability actually used

tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
